units.source_text: “我怎么可能爱除了你以外的女子呢。

en.t: How could I possibly love any woman other than you?

units.source_text: 哪怕成为整个埃及的笑柄，我也绝不纳一个妾……

en.t: Even if I became the laughingstock of all Egypt, I would never take a concubine...

units.source_text: 我要为你建造一间最美的闺房。”

en.t: I will build the most beautiful private chamber for you.
